reason: Virtual shoes from a gacha that you repair and level up with points is exactly how STEPN looked before it fell apart, and if the points can't become money anyway, I don't see why I'd grind shoes instead of just logging my Han River runs in the app I already use. What I need to get going again is a reason to show up, not another game to manage.
objection: This is STEPN in a new outfit. Either it eventually turns into a coin scheme that collapses, or the shoes and points are worthless and just there to keep me tapping. Either way my run data and my crew end up on an app that might not be around next year.
would_change_my_mind: If people from my own running crew were already using it for crew runs, and it had been running for a year or more without the shoe/point economy being reset or turned into crypto.
